$comment: Which ROA release the bundled docs were verified against. Read by scripts/check-doc-currency.mjs at session start to warn when the target project is on a different version. Bump roaVersion and verifiedOn whenever the docs are re-verified.
provenance: Signatures were read from ROA sources jars and example projects rather than inferred from names.

1.0.0-SNAPSHOT is a moving target: the same version string can resolve to different bytes over time, so matching versions does not by itself prove these docs are current. Generated Pandora metadata always outranks them.
